title: fleet-granularity-autoscaler-and-per-pool-minimum-throughput-guard
author: Priya Menon
description: Motivation: some fleets with mixed pool sizes and bursty tenants were observing transient drops in per-tenant throughput when the autoscaler downscaled coarse-grained slots. This PR introduces a new "fleet granularity autoscaler" that reasons about per-pool minimum throughput floors and a lightweight ephemeral micro-slot reservation to absorb short microbursts while preserving long-term fairness. The change has three parts: 1) allocator: introduce per-pool minimum throughput guards and a new soft-reservation API for ephemeral micro-slots; 2) autoscaler: a granularity-aware scale decision that penalizes downscales that would violate pool floors and adjusts target replica counts using a weighted hysteresis; 3) telemetry: emit a new sampled utilization heatmap and per-pool min-throughput breach counter to drive alerting and future ML-based tuning. Implementation notes: the autoscaler uses a 3-window moving median of observed throughput per pool, computes candidate downscale deltas, and simulates micro-slot assignment to ensure long-tail tenants are not catastrophically impacted. The soft-reservation path is conservative by default and enabled behind feature-flag rw.feature.fleet_granularity. Backwards compatibility: existing reservation and burst token flows remain unchanged; the new soft-reservation is additive and only used for transient requests. Tests: unit tests for allocation logic, integration tests for autoscaler decisions, and an end-to-end e2e that runs a synthetic burst profile against a three-pool cluster. Rollout plan: feature-flag gated, monitor new telemetry for 72 hours behind canary ratio 10% then ramp. Checklist: - [x] Implement allocator guards and soft-reservation API - [x] Add autoscaler decision logic and hysteresis tuning - [x] Emit telemetry and wire to prometheus metrics - [x] Unit and integration tests - [x] e2e test and manual canary validation - [x] Docs (ops runbook and rwctl helper) Links: Linear ENG-1123 for requirement, SUP-4421 for customer incident repro and logs.

release_notes: Introduce fleet granularity autoscaler that respects per-pool minimum throughput floors.
Add soft-reservation micro-slots to absorb short-lived bursts without impacting long-term fairness.
New telemetry: sampled utilization heatmap and per-pool min-throughput breach counter.
Feature flagged under rw.feature.fleet_granularity; default OFF for main clusters.
